mapper.select: SELECT CUI_USERNO FROM CPR_USER_INF WHERE CUI_USERID =#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CPR_USER_INF (CUI_USERNO, CUI_ECIFNO, CUI_USERID, CUI_USERNAME, CUI_OPENDATE) VALUES (#{userno}, #{ecino}, #{userId}, #{username},TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'yyyymmdd'))
mapper.update: update CPR_RULE set CRR_RULEDEF = #{udStatue} WHERE CRR_RULETYPE='TrsDef' AND CRR_RULEID='UkeyOpenFlag' AND CRR_USERTYPE='1'
mapper.select: select count(*) from CPR_RULE where CRR_RULEDEF = '1' AND CRR_RULETYPE='TrsDef' AND CRR_RULEID='UkeyOpenFlag' AND CRR_USERTYPE='1'
mapper.update: update CPR_TOKEN_INFO set CTI_CUSTOMERID = #{0}, CTI_CREATETIME = #{1} , CTI_TOKEN_STATUS = '0',CTI_USECOUNT='0' where CTI_TOKEN = #{2}
